value.rationale: Provides a closed-form optimum for a motivated natural subfamily of an explicit open sorted-optimum conjecture: exactly three distinct type values with unbounded multiplicities and arbitrary positive gaps. Three support points are the first case with unavoidable positive optimal cost; the theorem separates free-size from published fixed-size unsorted behavior and yields an immediate algorithm. It does not purport to solve the general conjecture.
